plugin.note: The charged Wilderness weapons (Viggora's chainmace, Craw's bow, Thammaron's sceptre) are far more effective against revenants when charged with revenant ether, and a Krystilia revenants task boosts their drop rate 5x. The wiki lists no elemental weakness, so pick the style you can sustain in the Wilderness. Wear low-risk gear and keep a one-click escape teleport ready.

requirements: A charged Wilderness weapon (Viggora's chainmace, Craw's bow or Thammaron's sceptre) with revenant ether
mechanics: Revenants heal when dropped below 50% Hitpoints, so sustained damage output matters more than burst.
Revenants adapt their attack style (melee/ranged/magic) to the player; a single protection prayer reduces but does not stop their damage.
The Revenant Caves are singles-plus combat: no dwarf multicannon, and player killers can attack you while you fight a revenant.
Being undead, revenants take extra damage from the salve amulet (e) - though its Wilderness use competes with the charged-weapon slots and gear choices.

methods.label: Melee (Viggora's chainmace)
methods.summary: Kill revenants with a charged Viggora's chainmace and low-risk melee gear.
recommendedFor: players who want the cheapest charged Wilderness weapon
requiredOrKeyItems: Viggora's chainmace charged with revenant ether
steps: Charge Viggora's chainmace with revenant ether before entering.
Enter the Revenant Caves and find an unoccupied revenant, preferring higher-level types for better drops.
Use one protection prayer and eat before dropping below half health, since revenants heal under 50% HP.
Watch the minimap for player killers and teleport immediately if threatened - cannons cannot be used here.
notes: Viggora's chainmace is the cheapest of the three charged Wilderness weapons.
A Krystilia revenants task multiplies the Wilderness weapon drop rate by 5.

methods.label: Ranged (Craw's bow)
methods.summary: Range revenants with a charged Craw's bow to stay mobile against player killers.
recommendedFor: players who prefer distance in the Wilderness
staying mobile near an escape route
requiredOrKeyItems: Craw's bow charged with revenant ether
steps: Charge Craw's bow with revenant ether before entering.
Attack revenants from distance, keeping moving toward an exit if player killers appear.
Flick a protection prayer and eat above 50% HP to avoid their heal.
Teleport out at the first sign of danger.
notes: Ranged keeps you mobile, which helps against player killers in the singles-plus caves.
The wiki lists no elemental weakness, so ranged is as valid as melee.

methods.label: Magic (Thammaron's sceptre)
methods.summary: Cast with a charged Thammaron's sceptre for a low-cost magic option.
recommendedFor: players training Magic in the Wilderness
hybrid setups that swap styles against adapting revenants
requiredOrKeyItems: Thammaron's sceptre charged with revenant ether
steps: Charge Thammaron's sceptre with revenant ether before entering.
Attack revenants from distance and keep your protection prayer up.
Eat above half health to deny their sub-50% heal.
Escape at once if a player killer approaches - no cannon can cover you here.
notes: Thammaron's sceptre is a cheap charged option for magic users.
Revenant demons and higher have notable Magic levels, so magic defence against them is not their weakest point - style choice is about survivability, not a stated weakness.
